links.title: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated 'slop' | TechCrunch
links.description: LinkedIn is introducing new ways to reduce low-quality AI-generated posts, including a “seems like AI slop” reporting option. It's also replacing its own AI writing feature with a proofreading tool.
